item.title: Implement atomic thread-safe ledger
item.brief: Implement ledger.py to match SPEC.md exactly and add focused tests to the existing suite. Requirements: constructor accepts only a dict with nonempty built-in string keys and built-in integer (not bool) values in [0, MAX_BALANCE]; empty dict allowed; invalid input raises ValueError. Copy input. snapshot returns an independent dict. transfer validates amount first (built-in int, not bool, in [1, MAX_BALANCE]), then account existence (unknown raises KeyError); return False without mutation for insufficient funds or destination overflow; successful transfer debits/credits exactly and conserves total. No account creation. Same-account transfers return True iff sufficient funds, with no balance change, including at MAX_BALANCE. Make calls linearizable per ledger across threads: check-and-write and snapshot are synchronized, and opposite-direction calls cannot deadlock. Add focused deterministic standard-library tests for constructor validation and copying, amount-validation precedence, unknown accounts, insufficient funds, overflow atomicity, same-account boundaries, snapshot isolation, conservation, and thread safety/absence of deadlock. Follow existing style and use only the Python standard library. Run the focused tests and commit the change as requested.

pr.body: Uses one per-ledger lock for account lookup, balance checks, both writes, and snapshots. Constructor and amount validation follow SPEC.md; snapshots and constructor inputs are copied. Added focused coverage for invalid inputs, precedence, missing and unhashable accounts, atomic failures, same-account boundaries, isolation, conservation, and concurrent opposite transfers. Verified with `python -m unittest -v` (10 passed), `python -m py_compile ledger.py test_ledger.py`, and `git diff --check`. Whole-change review of 45b99d7 found one blocking unhashable-account exception issue; commit 560e22a fixes it, and the delta review from 45b99d7 to 560e22a passed. No follow-ups remain.
pr.summary: Implemented validated, atomic ledger transfers and isolated snapshots. Before: ledger methods were stubs; now: transfers preserve bounds and totals under concurrent access. Changed ledger.py and test_ledger.py.
